summary: Expand call spread arguments using the iterable protocol while preserving argument order and this binding.

target.notes: Each spread operand is iterated via GetIterator; non-spread arguments and iterated values are appended in source order. Iterator side effects/errors are observable.

semantics.iterator_close: must follow abrupt-completion rules when required

caveats: Do not implement call spread using apply's CreateListFromArrayLike.
Strings and custom iterables must work; plain array-like non-iterables must fail.

tests.name: custom iterable spread
tests.input: const it={[Symbol.iterator]:function*(){yield 2;yield 3}}; function f(a,b){return a+b}; console.log(f(...it));
